# Charlie Sloane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy notable for his distinctive physical features. He is described as having prominent, goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors clear ambitions for his future career. He aspires to enter the political sphere and eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who had previously indulged in literary flights. He attended the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under the instruction of Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and later Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Alongside his peers, he studied in a classroom marked by academic rivalries and minor feuds.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are presumed rivals for the affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). While [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) acts as Anne's primary academic competitor at school, Charlie also views him as a romantic competitor for her good graces.
